Though '''popcorn''' is commonly available pre-popped or in microwave-oven ready popping bags, it is simple to make from scratch. In this recipe, "fine" or "popcorn salt" is helpful, because it sticks more easily, and imparts strong flavor with less of the ingredient.

== Ingredients ==
*½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] unpopped popcorn kernels
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] fine salt (non-iodized for those who prefer it)
*6 tbsp [[Cookbook:Clarified Butter|clarified butter]], divided
*Finely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] herbs, such as [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]] and/or [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]] (optional)
*[[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|Cayenne pepper]] (optional)
*Brewer's yeast (optional)

== Procedure ==
[[File:Jumping popcorn.ogv|thumbnail|Popping corns|308x308px]]
#Heat a large stainless steel bowl (or cast-iron [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet]]) over medium heat. Once hot, add 1 tsp clarified butter, salt, and popcorn kernels and cover with perforated [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|aluminum foil]] or spatter screen.
#Cook, shaking the pan continuously with tongs, for 45 seconds to 1 minute, or until popping slows to about 3 seconds between pops.
#Move popped corn to a large serving bowl, leaving any unpopped kernels behind.
#[[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|Toss]] with melted butter, salt, and any optional seasonings. Serve warm.
